standalone.description: You can also generate a pseudonym that is not linked to an existing entity. TrustDeck will create an internal standalone identifier for this pseudonym.
standalone.selected: Standalone pseudonym mode is active. Select the pseudonym domain in which the pseudonym should be saved.
standalone.modalDescription: Select the pseudonym domain and provide the identifier data. Additional pseudonym attributes are available under advanced options.

fields.validityTimeHelp: Examples: 3days, 1 day, 50 day, 7w, or 5 y. If a valid-to date is provided, the validity period is ignored.

selectedEntity.title: Selected entity identifier
selectedEntity.trustDeckIdHint: Entity-based pseudonyms use the entity TrustDeckID with identifier type TrustDeckID, so the pseudonym can be listed as a link of the entity later.

management.searchDescription: Search for pseudonyms in the selected pseudonym domain and manage the results.
management.generateDescription: Create a pseudonym for an existing entity or from identifier data.
management.entityDescription: Search for an entity, select it, and choose the pseudonym domain in which the pseudonym should be generated.
management.standaloneDescription: Provide an identifier and ID Type directly, then choose the pseudonym domain and optional validity settings.
management.secondaryDescription: Use an existing pseudonym as the identifier for a new pseudonym.
management.secondaryFormDescription: The source pseudonym is used as the fixed identifier for this secondary pseudonym.
management.secondaryIdTypeHint: Use <source-domain>_PSN as the ID Type whenever possible.
management.batchDescription: Map a CSV or XLSX file and create pseudonyms in sequential requests.

batch.title: Batch pseudonymization import
batch.description: Import one file into one pseudonym domain. The file is parsed locally and is never uploaded.
batch.fileDrop: Drop one CSV or XLSX file here
batch.fileTypes: CSV and XLSX only. Maximum file size: 25 MB; maximum rows: 50,000.
batch.xlsxIdentifierWarning: Store identifiers as text in the spreadsheet. Leading zeros cannot be recovered if the spreadsheet already stored them as a plain number.
batch.mappingSuggestion: Mappings are deterministic suggestions. Review every required and optional mapping before continuing.
batch.fixedIdType: Or enter one fixed ID Type for all rows
batch.mappingDuplicateWarning: The same source column is mapped more than once. Confirm that this is intentional.
batch.includeDuplicateRows: Submit later rows with the same identifier and ID Type (I acknowledge the warning)
batch.permissionDenied: The cached permission data does not grant pseudonym:create-batch for this domain. The backend remains authoritative.
batch.noRetry: Requests are sequential and are not automatically retried after uncertain failures.

fileErrors.unsupported-extension: Unsupported file type. Choose a CSV or XLSX file.
fileErrors.xls-not-supported: Legacy XLS files are not supported. Open the file in a spreadsheet application and save it as XLSX or CSV.
fileErrors.file-too-large: The selected file exceeds the 25 MB frontend safety limit.
fileErrors.parse-failed: The file could not be parsed.
fileErrors.no-worksheets: The workbook does not contain a worksheet.
fileErrors.no-usable-rows: The file does not contain usable rows.
fileErrors.too-many-rows: The file exceeds the 50,000-row frontend safety limit.

validation.invalidDate: The date does not match the selected format.
validation.dateOrder: Valid-to must be later than valid-from.
validation.validityConflict: Valid-to and validity period cannot both be submitted.
validation.duplicatePair: Duplicate identifier and ID Type; only the first row is submitted by default.
validation.duplicatePseudonym: Duplicate supplied pseudonym in this import; this is blocking.
validation.emptyRow: The row has no mapped data.

results.rejected: The backend rejected this request. Individual row reasons were not returned.
